Sport fields:

All-weather surface (Regularly maintained permeable granular field for recreational, permitted use),

Ball diamond - skinned in-field (Regularly maintained soil-based ball diamond with skinned in-field for recreational, permitted use),

Ball diamond - turf in-field (Regularly maintained soil-based ball diamond with skinned base pads for recreational, permitted use),

Synthetic turf field (Regularly maintained synthetic sport field for recreational, permitted use),

Class A field (soil or sand based game field for sports, well manicured, irrigated),

Class B field (soil based grass field, practice field for sports, non-irrigated),

Class C field (soil based grass area, infrequent maintenance, non-irrigated).

For information on all turf types, see these datasets as well: Turf, Natural Areas, Boulevards, and Meadows.

Data are updated by city staff as needed, and copied to the Open Data Portal on a weekly basis. The "Last Updated" date shown on our Open Data Portal refers to the last time the data schema was modified in the portal, or any changes were made to this description.  We update our data through daily scripts which does not trigger the "last updated" date to change.

Note: Attributes represent each field in a dataset, and some fields will contain information such as ID numbers.  As a result some visualizations on the tabs on our Open Data page will not be relevant.
